capabilities: Convert currencies, lengths, masses, and temperatures inline in rendered notes
Preserve original values unchanged in the Markdown source
Show original and alternate conversions on hover or tap
Load exchange rates from a Markdown, JSON, or CSV file in the vault
extras: The plugin never accesses the network; currency rates come from a user-owned vault file. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Explicit markers prevent dates, version numbers, and code from being misinterpreted as measurements.
problem: Obsidian shows values exactly as written, so readers have to manually convert currencies, lengths, masses, and temperatures or clutter their notes with duplicates.
summary: Unit and currency converter that displays values in your preferred units inline while keeping the original Markdown text unchanged.
